result.answer: The transfer to WARD-B (bed BAY2-04, event time 08:20 UTC) failed because the demo bed-management system was unavailable and answered with an error. A first plan was to resend it unchanged. The gate held that resend back, because a newer transfer for the same encounter was still waiting to be delivered. Shutter waited for that newer message to arrive, then planned the case again. The bed-management system then took that later transfer to WARD-C (bed BAY1-07, event time 08:45 UTC), and its record now shows the patient on WARD-C. The failed transfer had been overtaken. Resending it would have moved the patient back to WARD-B, where they no longer are. So the case closed as superseded, with nothing sent. No receipt shows the failed transfer was ever applied, and no one needs to take any action. If the site treated this system as a full record of every move, the case would have gone to a person instead of closing (W1).

response.content: I sent the answer: the transfer wasn't resent because a later transfer to WARD-C had already reached the bed-management system, so resending would have moved the patient back to WARD-B.
